description: Runs ONE prompt through the explore_ai_prompt pipeline and checks a brand plus its named competitors against the SAME real per-model answers for mentions and citations. Bounded scope, stated plainly: this is what one prompt's observed answers show for the named entities — never a comprehensive cross-prompt visibility score. `mentionedByCount` / `citedByCount` are raw counts out of `successfulModelCount`, never a percentage or ranking. `entities[0]` is always the target brand; the rest are the competitors in submitted order. A model that failed upstream reports `status: "error"` with `mentioned`/`cited: null` for every entity — null, not false, because that model was never checked. REQUIRES A PAID PLAN and CHARGES the same as explore_ai_prompt for the requested models; comparing more competitors against that one set of answers costs nothing extra.

brand.description: The target brand, domain or product checked in each answer.

competitors.description: 1-5 competitor brands/domains checked against the same answers.

models.description: 1-4 model personas, as for explore_ai_prompt (persona labels, not vendor-verified models).

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

prompt.description: The one prompt every requested model answers.

webSearch.description: Ground the answers in a real retrieval pass with cited sources. Defaults to true.

webSearchCountryCode.description: Two-letter country the retrieval pass searches from.

name: compare_ai_competitor_positioning
